description.value: Albion Pizzeria is a locally-operated pizza shop in Maple Ridge that makes its dough fresh in-house daily and sources ingredients locally. The business explicitly markets itself as a refuelling stop for cyclists heading to or from Albion Park, and sits in a central unit plaza making it a convenient mid-ride stop. The menu spans classic and creative pizzas, chicken, wings, and ice cream, with online ordering and local delivery available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms Albion Pizzeria is an active pizza restaurant at 24155 102 Ave, Unit 103, Maple Ridge BC, with phone (604) 477-4321. The About Us page explicitly mentions cyclists — 'If you're biking up Albion Park … Albion Pizzeria is the best spot to refuel' — making this clearly cyclist-relevant. The menu has a dedicated Vegetarian category and a 'To-Go' section plus online ordering confirming takeout; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or other amenity details are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address field contains only '102 Avenue' with no house number or city; website provides complete address '24155 102 Ave, Unit 103, Maple Ridge, BC V2W 2C6' — used website value.
FAQ page contains boilerplate text referencing 'Domino's products' (e.g. Question 1), suggesting the FAQ was copied from a template and not fully customized; content reliability of that page is low.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business explicitly calls out cyclists as a target audience and is an active, legitimate food stop, but none of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence — an on-the-ground check is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The About Us page contains the phrase 'If you're biking up Albion Park or soaking up the local culture downtown, Albion Pizzeria in Maple Ridge is the best spot to refuel' — strong signal of cyclist awareness that could be highlighted once required criteria are verified.
